# Blockmate

> > Blockmate is a crypto-as-a-service platform connecting banks and fintech companies with Web3 through APIs, compliance tools, and payment solutions.

Blockmate provides enterprise-grade infrastructure for integrating cryptocurrency services into traditional financial systems. The platform offers modular products for portfolio management, payments processing, AML compliance, and NFT handling across multiple blockchains.

## Key Topics

- Blockmate API
- Web3 Integration
- AML Compliance
- Blockmate Portfolio
- Blockmate Payments
- Blockmate Explorer
- Wallet Aggregation
- Crypto Accounting
- NFT Management
- Risk Scoring
- Compliance Tools
- Digital Assets
- Blockmate Link
- On-ramp Solutions
- Crypto Tax Automation

## Core Platform

- [Blockmate · We connect banks and fintech with crypto](https://www.blockmate.io): Blockmate crypto-as-a-service platform connecting banks and fintech with Web3
- [Blockmate Portfolio · Blockmate products](https://www.blockmate.io/solution/blockmate-portfolio): Blockmate Portfolio for multi-account crypto aggregation and tracking
- [Blockmate Payments · Blockmate products](https://www.blockmate.io/solution/blockmate-payments): Blockmate Payments for seamless crypto transactions with AML compliance
- [Blockmate AML Explorer](https://www.blockmate.io/blockmate-explorer): Blockmate Explorer for AML compliance and wallet analysis
